title: Authentication requirements not visible in API inspection output
description: When inspecting an API or its operations, authentication requirements are shown as null even though the API requires authentication. This makes it difficult for agents to understand what credentials they need.
reproduction_steps: Observe that auth requirements show as null
expected_behavior: Authentication requirements should be clearly displayed showing the required security schemes (e.g., OAuth2, API key, etc.)
actual_behavior: Auth requirements display as null in both 'jentic apis show' output and 'jentic inspect' output
evidence: Authentication requirements not visible in 'jentic apis show' output; agent noted this as data quality issue
Found the operation, but auth requirements show as null
Agent narration: 'I can see the endpoint, but I don't see authentication requirements yet'

title: OpenAPI specifications missing security scheme definitions
description: Downloaded OpenAPI specifications do not include security scheme definitions even for APIs that require authentication, making it impossible to understand authentication requirements from the spec.
reproduction_steps: Examine the spec for security or securitySchemes sections
Observe that security requirements are not documented
expected_behavior: OpenAPI spec should include securitySchemes definitions and security requirements on operations
actual_behavior: Security information is missing from the downloaded OpenAPI specification
evidence: Got the spec, but it doesn't show security requirements either
Agent narration: 'Downloaded OpenAPI spec via 'jentic cat'; noted security requirements not visible'

title: Audit event records contain null or incomplete event type fields
description: When viewing audit events, some records have null or missing event type information, reducing the usefulness of the audit log.
reproduction_steps: Observe null event types in some records
expected_behavior: All audit events should have properly populated event type fields
actual_behavior: Some audit event records have null event types
evidence: Agent summary mentions 'null event types' as a data quality issue
Agent evaluation log notes 'Minor data quality issues (empty toolkit names, null event types)'
